title: One of the things I love about my MallWorld and some observations
content: My Mall World tends to be very crowded and busy but no one is on their phones. Everyone is engaged in the activities and world around them. I think that's part of the "nostalgia" I get from it. Although, I do find myself going to a computer lab to do some work relatively often, but I think that's one of my specific high school coded nostalgic aspects (?)
